Name: Aram, Son of Shem
Summary: Aram was a son of Shem and the father of Uz, Hul, Gether, and Mash.
KeyStory: Aram's sons became the Aramean peoples, neighbors of Israel for centuries to come.
RelatedPeople: Shem; Uz, Son of Aram; Hul; Gether; Mash
LifeLesson: God's promise to fill the earth moved forward through families like this one.
